verified_geometry.delay_definition: receiver-aircraft slant path plus transmitter-aircraft slant path minus transmitter-receiver baseline
verified_geometry.doppler_definition: negative bistatic excess-path rate divided by carrier wavelength

findings.finding: The headline denominator treats all detector-searchable cells across the full ambiguity map as equivalent proven radar reach.
findings.impact: Map coverage is not a validated sensitivity envelope. Distant or poor bistatic geometry can dominate the miss count.
findings.correction: Report fixed excess-delay and receiver-slant-range strata while retaining the honest map-wide result. Establish a reach envelope only from a predeclared, pass-disjoint validation cohort.

findings.finding: Frames below process.detection.minDelay were counted as physically eligible misses.
findings.impact: A deliberately unsearched cell could be charged to radar recall.
findings.observed_current_hour_pass_effect: No current eligible pass appears to be explained solely by this defect; it is real but not the main low-yield cause.
findings.correction: Eligibility now requires delay >= the detector floor and the evaluation-contract hash includes this rule.

findings.finding: Near-tied ADS-B candidates cause a radar detection or track point to be discarded silently.
findings.impact: Dense traffic can invalidate a genuine cell without a visible rejected-association count.
findings.correction: Expose cumulative detection/tracker point, candidate, unmatched, ambiguous and selected counts. Preserve rejection rather than inventing an aircraft identity.

findings.finding: Kraken event time remains a host-arrival estimate with unbounded transport uncertainty.
findings.impact: Live association is operational/provisional and may undercount even though the four-CPI wait and projection order are correct.
findings.correction: Keep decision_grade false and report timing provenance. This audit does not claim exact UTC.

evidence.support_note: Observed support is descriptive, not an authorized reach cutoff.

local_fix.mix_control: The live scorecard now computes a pooled direct-standardized current-hour versus previous-hour comparison on common primary excess-delay x receiver-slant strata. It is decision-grade only with at least 80% common-support coverage and exact timing; raw percentages remain descriptive.
local_fix.deployment: not deployed; must land as a focused follow-up after the current timing/capture PR boundary
